name: Button: Launch Party Picker For Meeting Attendee
purpose: Button on the Meeting layout that opens the contact picker (Picker Module, multi-select, no create) to add attendees: installs a 1-second on-timer that runs the selection handler, commits, and calls Show Contact Picker with the window options.
calls:
Picker_Module.fmp12/scripts/67 "Show Contact Picker( { top { ; left { ; allowMultiple } } } )" (step 12, in=Picker_Module.fmp12)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/676 "Handler: Meeting Attendee Selection" (step 3, Install OnTimer Script)
open_question: Hands off to the Picker Module file, whose picked result is read by script 676.

name: Handler: Meeting Attendee Selection
purpose: Timer handler that runs after the contact picker: runs Contact Handler Common Tests, returns -1 if the user cancelled, otherwise for each picked party creates an ActivityParty on the meeting with role 60 (attendee) through karbon_kontroller Create ActivityParty, with the party's cached email id and address. Stops the timer once a pick was made.
calls:
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/63 "Contact Handler Common Tests" (step 8)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/376 "Create ActivityParty { json }" (step 47, in=karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
open_question: $Comments is never set, so Comments is always empty. Reads PartyCount from key Result.CountPicked while the sample comment shows PartyCount. The creation of the ActivityParty record happens in karbon_kontroller (script 376).

name: Button: Create Meeting From Opportunity
purpose: Button that creates a Meeting from the current Opportunity: picks the first related person when the opportunity's party is an organization (otherwise the opportunity's party), calls karbon_kontroller Create Meeting with EntityId = opportunity id and EntityTypeId 13, then opens the new meeting in a window with the related contacts, salesperson and referring party as display parties.
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/545 "Create Meeting { data }" (step 14, in=karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/291 "Open Activity { Id }" (step 27)
open_question: $Location is never set, so Location is empty. Entity type id 13 (Opportunity) is hard-coded.

name: Open Meeting in New Window { Id }
purpose: Opens the meeting whose Id is in the script parameter in a new 1080x800 document window on the Meeting Detail layout and puts the cursor in Activity::Subject; shows an error dialog when the Id is missing.

name: Button: Create Meeting From Party
purpose: Button that creates a Meeting from the current Party: uses the first related person when the party is an organization (otherwise the party), calls karbon_kontroller Create Meeting, then opens the new meeting in a window with the person, related persons and the party's activity parties as display parties.
reads:
Party::OrganizationInd#18 (step 3)
Party_PartyRelation_Party::Id#1 (step 5)
Party::Id#1 (step 7)
Opportunity::Id#1 (step 11)
Person::Id#1 (step 23)
Party_PartyRelation_Party_Person::Id#1 (step 23)
Party_ActivityParty::PartyIdList#59 (step 23)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/545 "Create Meeting { data }" (step 13, in=karbon_kontroller.fmp12)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/291 "Open Activity { Id }" (step 25)
open_question: The create call sends EntityId = Opportunity::Id and EntityTypeId 13 (Opportunity) although the script runs from a Party layout; likely copied from the opportunity version, so the entity link may be wrong. $Location is never set.
